long_biography.plain_text:
Claude Thiriet trained as a baker and pastry maker before taking over his family's Éloyes bakery in 1966. He expanded beyond the inherited shop by developing ice creams, using a refrigerated vehicle and catalogue to reach customers at home, and investing in industrial production.

That model grew into Maison Thiriet, an integrated frozen-food company combining manufacturing, home delivery and specialist retail stores. Thiriet remains president and participates in product tasting and quality decisions, while operating teams handle day-to-day management. New recipes move through development and industrialisation before he helps decide which products enter the range.

uncertainties.detail: No open public source names the owner of the authoritative private-vessel relationships. The Maison Thiriet identity is resolved at very high confidence through the uncommon exact name, French nationality and residence, 1946 birth year, registry full name and convergent current-company record. The absence of a public vessel bridge prevents a 100 score.

The authoritative record says 11 December 1946. The detailed exact-person biography says 12 November 1946, while French company-register records independently place the Maison Thiriet president's birth in November 1946. The dossier therefore proposes correcting the month at very high confidence and the day at high confidence, treating the source value as a likely day-month transposition.

Reviewed sources describe birth in the Vosges and upbringing in Éloyes, but they do not provide a sufficiently consistent, precise birth town from a high-quality source. No place-of-birth proposal is made.

The original bakery was founded by Thiriet's grandfather and passed to Claude, so wealth origin is Inherited and expanded. Founder describes Claude's creation of the modern frozen-food manufacturing and direct-distribution platform, not the establishment of the predecessor bakery.

Current official material identifies Thiriet as president, and independent reporting documents continued product-tasting and quality involvement. Daily executive management has been delegated, so the dossier does not imply that he personally runs every operating function.

Focused LinkedIn, Instagram and personal-website searches found only unrelated namesakes or insufficiently linked accounts. No personal social is proposed; the exact official company website is the sole social proposal.

An active Claude Thiriet individual business is registered through a Cannes marina-services address, but its public record lacks a date of birth or connection to Maison Thiriet. It is not used as an identity bridge, biography fact, wealth mechanism, social proposal or tag basis. Unrelated obituary records for Claude Thiriets born in 1939 and 1942 were also excluded.

Food manufacturing and Grocery retail are the minimum useful active tags because they capture distinct production and direct-distribution dimensions of the vertically integrated company. The overlapping Branded foods tag was not added, no inactive concept was used and no taxonomy candidate was created.
